summary: Reconstitution of Central Empowered Committee; ad hoc functioning corrected via institutionalization; CEC now permanent body under Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 s.3(3); monitoring compliance of court orders on forests/wildlife; powers include document summons, site inspections, co-opting officials; re-examination of aged/inaccessible members; notification dated 05.09.2023 approved; functions limited to forest/environment law implementation.
final_judgment: CEC institutionalized as permanent statutory body; Notification dated 05.09.2023 approved; CEC continues subject to court supervision.
